# netbox_vpn_tunnel_group (Data Source)

Retrieves a single vpn tunnel group from NetBox. The lookup fails if no match or more than one match is found.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netbox_vpn_tunnel_group" "example" {
  name = "branches"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the vpn tunnel group.

### Optional

- `description` (String) A description of the vpn tunnel group.
- `slug` (String) The URL-friendly slug of the vpn tunnel group.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) The numeric ID of the vpn tunnel group.
- `tags` (Set of String) Tags assigned to the object, by name.
